title: Money: The Story We All Agreed to Believe
question: A dollar bill is just paper, and a bank balance is just a number in a database—so why does everyone act as if it were real?
summary: Money has almost no intrinsic value, yet it coordinates the labor of billions of strangers who will never meet, functioning less like a physical resource and more like a collectively hallucinated institution that only works because enough people believe in it at once.
